title: Core: AS2 prototype chain and __proto__
description: Test compilation of prototype manipulation: MyClass.prototype.method = function(){}, MyClass.prototype = new BaseClass(), obj.__proto__, obj.constructor.prototype, Object.prototype.toString, Function.prototype.call. Verify ActionGetMember (0x4f) for prototype access, ActionSetMember (0x4e) for prototype assignment. Test that prototype chain setup emits correct ActionNew + ActionSetMember sequence.
